purpose: Date-effective B3 trading/clearing fees for ordinary non-day-trade cash-equity orders executed at the opening. Broker fees and Central Depository account/custody pass-through are intentionally separate.

rules.source: B3 historical tariff policy, confirmed by B3 10-Dec-2020 tariff notice: ordinary non-day-trade cash equities were charged 0.0325% before the 02-Feb-2021 change; https://www.b3.com.br/pt_br/noticias/tarifacao.htm

B3 Circular 177/2020: 0.0050% negotiation + 0.0250% settlement for regular trades, with negotiation raised to 0.0070% during opening/closing auctions, totaling 0.0320%; current low-ADTV opening-auction tariff remains consistent with this treatment.

scope_note: These rules represent B3 transaction fees only. They do not assert that a broker charged zero brokerage, zero custody, zero account maintenance, or zero recurring service fees.
historical_custody_note: B3 Central Depository account/custody charges existed historically and their pass-through depended on the custodian/broker. The strict reconstruction runner therefore requires documentary evidence for recurring fees and refuses exact classification when a nonzero recurring fee is not explicitly modeled.
volume_tier_note: The post-2025 3.20 bps opening-auction figure corresponds to the lowest cash-equity ADTV tier. Very high-volume accounts require tier-aware fee reconstruction rather than this retail schedule.
